versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑וֹ וְעֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: Then he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits its length, and twenty cubits its breadth, and ten cubits its height.
controles.kjv: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
controles.livre: Fez ademais um altar de bronze de vinte côvados de comprimento, e vinte côvados de largura, e dez côvados de altura.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּֽ֠אַמָּה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ אֶל־שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָג֣וֹל׀ סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔וֹ וְקָו֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass; and its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.
controles.kjv: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
controles.livre: Também fez um mar de fundição, o qual tinha dez côvados do uma borda à outra, inteiramente redondo: sua altura era de cinco côvados, e uma linha de trinta côvados o contornava.

versos.hebraico: וּדְמ֣וּת בְּקָרִים֩ תַּ֨חַת ל֜וֹ סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ סוֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּיפִ֥ים אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנַ֤יִם טוּרִים֙ הַבָּקָ֔ר יְצוּקִ֖ים בְּמֻֽצַקְתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
controles.kjv: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
controles.livre: E debaixo dele havia figuras de bois que o circundavam, dez em cada côvado todo ao redor: eram duas ordens de bois fundidos juntamente com o mar.

versos.hebraico: עוֹמֵ֞ד עַל־שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים׀ צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלוֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים׀ יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכָל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה׃

controles.web: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set on them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.
controles.kjv: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
controles.livre: E estava assentado sobre doze bois, três dos quais estavam voltados ao norte, e três ao ocidente, e três ao sul, e três ao oriente: e o mar assentava sobre eles, e todas suas traseiras estavam à parte de dentro.

versos.hebraico: וְעָבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ֙ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂפַת־כּ֔וֹס פֶּ֖רַח שֽׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה מַחֲזִ֣יק בַּתִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים יָכִֽיל׃ס

controles.web: It was a hand breadth thick; and its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it received and held three thousand baths.
controles.kjv: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
controles.livre: E tinha de espessura um palmo, e a borda era da feitura da borda de um cálice, ou flor de lírio. E fazia três mil batos.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כִּיּוֹרִים֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַ֠יִּתֵּן חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה מִיָּמִ֜ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׂמֹאול֙ לְרָחְצָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָעוֹלָ֖ה יָדִ֣יחוּ בָ֑ם וְהַיָּ֕ם לְרָחְצָ֥ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: He made also ten basins, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them; such things as belonged to the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
controles.kjv: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
controles.livre: Fez também dez fontes, e pôs cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda, para lavar e limpar nelas a obra do holocausto; mas o mar era para os sacerdotes se lavarem nele.

versos.hebraico: וַ֠יַּעַשׂ אֶת־מְנֹר֧וֹת הַזָּהָ֛ב עֶ֖שֶׂר כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ מִיָּמִ֖ין וְחָמֵ֥שׁ מִשְּׂמֹֽאול׃ס

controles.web: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
controles.kjv: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
controles.livre: Fez também dez candelabros de ouro segundo sua forma, os quais pôs no templo, cinco à direita, e cinco à esquerda.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַיַּנַּח֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה מִיָּמִ֖ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה מִשְּׂמֹ֑אול וַיַּ֛עַשׂ מִזְרְקֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מֵאָֽה׃

controles.web: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.
controles.kjv: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
controles.livre: Também fez dez mesas e as pôs no templo, cinco à direita, e cinco à esquerda: igualmente fez cem bacias de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ֙ חֲצַ֣ר הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים וְהָעֲזָרָ֖ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וּדְלָת֧וֹת לָעֲזָרָ֛ה וְדַלְתוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם צִפָּ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with brass.
controles.kjv: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
controles.livre: A mais disto fez o átrio dos sacerdotes, e o grande átrio, e as entradas do átrio, e cobriu as portas de elas de bronze.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֧תֶף הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגְבָּה׃

controles.web: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.
controles.kjv: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
controles.livre: E assentou o mar ao lado direito até o oriente, em frente do sul.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חוּרָ֔ם אֶת־הַ֨סִּיר֔וֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹתס וַיְכַ֣ל חירם לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. So Huram made an end of doing the work that he did for king Solomon in God’s house:
controles.kjv: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
controles.livre: Fez também Hirão caldeiras, e pás, e bacias; e acabou Hirão a obra que fazia ao rei Salomão para a casa de Deus;

versos.hebraico: עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְהַגֻּלּ֧וֹת וְהַכֹּתָר֛וֹת עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְהַשְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָֽעַמּוּדִֽים׃

controles.web: the two pillars, and the bowls, and the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, and the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,
controles.kjv: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
controles.livre: Duas colunas, e os globos, os capitéis sobre as cabeças das duas colunas, e duas redes para cobrir as duas bolas dos capitéis que estavam encima das colunas;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הָֽרִמּוֹנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַשְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנַ֨יִם טוּרִ֤ים רִמּוֹנִים֙ לַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֔ת לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃

controles.web: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.
controles.kjv: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
controles.livre: Quatrocentas romãs nas duas redes, duas ordens de romãs em cada rede, para que cobrissem as duas bolas dos capitéis que estavam encima das colunas.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַמְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּר֥וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה עַל־הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: He made also the bases, and the basins made he on the bases;
controles.kjv: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
controles.livre: Fez também as bases, sobre as quais assentou as pias;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם אֶחָ֑ד וְאֶת־הַבָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

controles.web: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.
controles.kjv: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
controles.livre: O mar, e doze bois debaixo dele;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַ֠סִּירוֹת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֤ים וְאֶת־הַמִּזְלָגוֹת֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כְּלֵיהֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֞ה חוּרָ֥ם אָבִ֛יו לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מָרֽוּק׃

controles.web: Huram his father also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for king Solomon for Yahweh’s house of bright brass.
controles.kjv: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the Lord of bright brass.
controles.livre: E caldeiras, e pás, e garfos; e todos seus utensílios fez Hirão seu pai ao rei Salomão para a casa do SENHOR, de bronze puríssimo.

versos.hebraico: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּעֲבִ֖י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צְרֵדָֽתָה׃

controles.web: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
controles.kjv: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
controles.livre: E fundiu-os o rei nas planícies do Jordão, em terra argilosa, entre Sucote e Zeredá.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה כָּל־הַכֵּלִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָרֹ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ

controles.web: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
controles.kjv: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
controles.livre: E Salomão fez todos estes vasos em grande abundância, porque não pode ser achado o peso do bronze.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַכֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָנ֔וֹת וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃

controles.web: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house, the golden altar also, and the tables with the show bread on them;
controles.kjv: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
controles.livre: Assim fez Salomão todos os vasos para a casa de Deus, e o altar de ouro, e as mesas sobre as quais se punham os pães da proposição;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹר֞וֹת וְנֵרֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לְבַעֲרָ֧ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֥ב סָגֽוּר׃

controles.web: and the lamp stands with their lamps, to burn according to the ordinance before the oracle, of pure gold;
controles.kjv: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
controles.livre: Assim os candelabros e suas lâmpadas, de ouro puro, para que as acendessem diante do compartimento interno conforme à costume.

versos.hebraico: וְהַפֶּ֧רַח וְהַנֵּר֛וֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָ֑ב ה֖וּא מִכְל֥וֹת זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, of gold, and that perfect gold;
controles.kjv: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
controles.livre: E as flores, e as lâmpadas, e as tenazes se fizeram completamente de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וְהַֽמְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַכַּפּ֥וֹת וְהַמַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וּפֶ֣תַח הַ֠בַּיִת דַּלְתוֹתָ֨יו הַפְּנִימִיּ֜וֹת לְקֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְדַלְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת לַהֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold: and as for the entry of the house, the inner doors of it for the most holy place, and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.
controles.kjv: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
controles.livre: Também os apagadores, e as bacias, e as colheres, e os incensários, de ouro puro. Quanto à entrada da casa, suas portas interiores para o lugar santíssimo, e as portas da casa do templo, de ouro.
